tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: A recess inside an island: the board's rails, code blocks, and for now the panes that become islands of their own later (the chat list, the Editor's tree). A step dimmer than the island. No longer the sidebar: that is an island (design/islands).

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: Every island's fill: the sidebar and each page (design/islands). No border, no shadow: the step from the background sets it apart.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: What was the canvas sits on the island: the main column, code, terminals, what is cut out of a glyph or an avatar.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, run cards, kanban cards, secondary buttons, the text box; and inputs, selects, checkboxes, kbd, segmented controls, the Markdown editor, Go to file and agent chips, a step up from the island.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Old name for float, kept for call sites outside the app's stylesheets: use float.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: What floats over the islands and the background: menus, popovers, the palette, tooltips, drawers, toasts, the chip's hover card. A 1px line-2 border and shadow-pop; solid, no glass.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on an island (rows, nav items, ghost buttons), and of a row on float.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Current nav item, focused row, pressed segment, neutral badges. Never put text-3 on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside an island: card borders, row dividers, the chat list's foot. Never around an island: the gaps split the window.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: inputs, buttons, label pills, and the border of what floats.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on bg, raised, overlay, hover and selected.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav labels, meta, field labels. Reads on every surface.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Faint text: IDs, dates, hints, group counts. On the island, side, raised and float only (not on selected); on the background faint text is text-2.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, links, focus, selection. Not for status.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: agent avatars, info badges, focus halos, pressed label pills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary buttons, the org tile).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Teal means exactly one thing: an agent is working on this right now (pulse, Live badge, working strip, live run border).

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind live badges and the card working strip; the halo of a live run card.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: Review, holds, the Inbox count. Hersir's gold (in light a hair yellower than the brand's #9e5500, so On hold's red stays 35° of hue away). Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: needs-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind needs-you badges and the Inbox count.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Succeeded runs, QA passed, done. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings in forms, idle agents, budget at 80 %. A yellow, at least 35° of hue from needs. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning badges and the idle state.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed runs, Stop, destructive actions, errors. Text on bg and raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind failure badges; danger button hover.

tokens.name: canvas-from
tokens.usage: The background behind the islands: its gradient at the window's top (design/islands).

tokens.name: canvas-to
tokens.usage: The background's gradient at the window's bottom edge: the light of the mountains, hue 237°.

tokens.name: canvas-glow
tokens.usage: The glow from the window's top left, full for 45% of the way, fading to transparent at 60% of its width and 75% of its height. Hersir's cool blue, low in chroma: never accent, live or needs.

tokens.name: glass-from
tokens.usage: canvas-from as glass, over the desktop the system blurs (the glass comes with islands card 3).

tokens.name: glass-to
tokens.usage: canvas-to as glass.

tokens.name: glass-glow
tokens.usage: canvas-glow as glass.

tokens.name: canvas-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a button on the background (the top bars' buttons): translucent, so it shows on any glass.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: A scrollbar's thumb at rest: 6px (size-scroll), a pill, no track.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: The thumb under the pointer and while it is dragged.

tokens.name: st-backlog
tokens.usage: Backlog glyph (dashed circle).

tokens.name: st-todo
tokens.usage: To do glyph (open circle).

tokens.name: st-progress
tokens.usage: In progress glyph (half-filled circle): warning's yellow, at least 35° of hue from needs.

tokens.name: st-testing
tokens.usage: Testing glyph (three-quarter circle): QA is checking it.

tokens.name: st-review
tokens.usage: Review glyph (circle with a dot): waiting for you.

tokens.name: st-done
tokens.usage: Done glyph (filled circle with a check).

tokens.name: st-blocked
tokens.usage: On-hold glyph (circle with a minus), on any column.

tokens.name: st-cancelled
tokens.usage: Cancelled glyph (struck circle).

tokens.name: pr-urgent
tokens.usage: The only coloured priority: the Urgent square. Other priorities are grey bars.

tokens.name: c-blue
tokens.usage: Label and project colour (decorative dot; the name carries the meaning).

tokens.name: c-teal
tokens.usage: Label and project colour.

tokens.name: c-yellow
tokens.usage: Label and project colour.

tokens.name: c-violet
tokens.usage: Label and project colour.

tokens.name: c-orange
tokens.usage: Label and project colour.

tokens.name: c-pink
tokens.usage: Label and project colour.

tokens.name: c-red
tokens.usage: Label and project colour (the bug label).

tokens.name: c-grey
tokens.usage: Label and project colour for internal work.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added: the + mark and the line number of an added line, + counts (+964), the A status letter. Text on bg, raised, selected and diff-add-soft.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed: the − mark and the old line number of a removed line, − counts (−112), the D status letter. Text on bg, raised, selected and diff-del-soft.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Behind an added line, its number and its + mark.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a removed line, its old number and its − mark.

tokens.name: diff-add-strong
tokens.usage: Behind the characters that changed inside an added line, drawn over diff-add-soft.

tokens.name: diff-del-strong
tokens.usage: Behind the characters that changed inside a removed line, drawn over diff-del-soft.

tokens.name: diff-fold
tokens.usage: The fold bar between changes ("37 unchanged lines", ↑ 20, ↓ 20), with text-2 on it.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (fn, function, return, if, pub, use, const), self and this, Blade's directives (@if, @foreach, @php).

tokens.name: syn-meta
tokens.usage: <?php and ?>, Blade's {{ }} and {!! !!}, attributes (#[derive], #[Route]), decorators, escapes.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Functions and methods, where they're defined and called; macros (println!).

tokens.name: syn-tag
tokens.usage: HTML, Blade and JSX tags (div, x-button, Sidebar).

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, classes, structs, enums, interfaces, namespaces; Rust's lifetimes.

tokens.name: syn-attribute
tokens.usage: Attribute names in HTML, Blade and JSX (class, wire:model, onClick).

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Strings, characters, template strings, regular expressions, attribute values.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, true, false and null: literals, with the strings.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, doc comments and Blade's {{-- --}}.

tokens.name: syn-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and other names; the text of HTML and JSX.

tokens.name: syn-property
tokens.usage: Properties and fields ($this->total, task.title, self.files), JSON and YAML keys.

tokens.name: syn-operator
tokens.usage: Operators (= + -> => && ?:).

tokens.name: syn-punctuation
tokens.usage: Brackets, commas, semicolons, < > around tags.

tokens.name: syn-invalid
tokens.usage: What the parser can't read (an unclosed tag): with a wavy underline, so it isn't colour alone.

tokens.name: git-modified
tokens.usage: Git's M and R marks in the Editor's file tree, tabs and status bar, and the dot on a folder with changes inside.

tokens.name: git-added
tokens.usage: Git's A and U marks in the Editor's file tree, tabs and status bar.

tokens.name: git-deleted
tokens.usage: Git's D and C marks in the Editor's file tree, tabs and status bar.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Text a program prints without a colour, and the prompt; as the code's text.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The terminal's background: the code's, so the Editor's panel and the code above it are one surface.

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor: a block while the terminal has the focus, its outline while it hasn't; it doesn't blink.

tokens.name: term-cursor-text
tokens.usage: The character under the block cursor.

tokens.name: term-selection
tokens.usage: The selection, and find's matches (the current one with an accent border): accent at 26% (dark) and 18% (light) on bg, opaque so xterm.js's search can use it.

tokens.name: term-selection-inactive
tokens.usage: The selection while the terminal hasn't the focus.

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 0. Dark: a block a little above the background (ls's fifos, htop's bars), and black text on coloured blocks; as text on the background xterm.js lifts it to 4.5:1.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 1: errors, failed tests, git's removed lines and unstaged files. diff-del's value, so git diff reads as the Changes view.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 2: success, passed tests, git's added lines and staged files. diff-add's value.

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 3: warnings, git's commit hashes. The gold of syn-type.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 4: folders in ls, rustc's arrows and line numbers. The blue of syn-function.

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 5: images in ls. A violet: at least 35° of hue from needs (gold, “needs you”).

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 6: symbolic links in ls, git's @@ lines, URLs. A sky blue: at least 35° of hue from live (teal, an agent at work).

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 7: light grey. In dark, text a little dimmer than term-fg; in light, white text on coloured blocks, and lifted to 4.5:1 when it is text on the background.

tokens.name: term-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 8: grey text, such as hints, a shell's suggestions and dim lines. text-3's old value: a terminal colour, kept when text-3 was lifted for the islands.

tokens.name: term-bright-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 9: bold red (xterm.js draws bold text in the bright colours).

tokens.name: term-bright-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 10: bold green, such as executables in ls and cargo's Compiling.

tokens.name: term-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 11: bold yellow, such as rustc's warning.

tokens.name: term-bright-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 12: bold blue, such as folders in ls.

tokens.name: term-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 13: bold magenta. As apart from needs as term-magenta.

tokens.name: term-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 14: bold cyan, such as symbolic links in ls. As apart from live as term-cyan.

tokens.name: term-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 15: the brightest white in dark; in light a pale block, lifted to 4.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a drawer or the palette.

tokens.name: band-subtle-line
tokens.usage: The mountains along the bottom of the first start's onboarding (GA-139), Subtle: the lines (currentColor of src/assets/mountains.svg). The app's window has the islands' gradient instead.

tokens.name: band-subtle-glow
tokens.usage: Subtle: the glow at the bottom edge, fading to nothing at the band's top.

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: The band's lines: the strength Jefsev picked (Subtle, 13 Oct 2026).

tokens.name: band-glow
tokens.usage: The band's glow: the strength Jefsev picked.
